title: Fail-closed capsule effect metadata
objective: Make immutable UInt64 lease writability fail closed when prime-source effects metadata is absent

oracles: generated wrapper with absent analysis/effects metadata

handoff.summary: Prime-source UInt64 buffer writability now defaults to writable whenever the optional effect proof is absent, so immutable leases fail closed instead of crashing wrapper generation or reaching a potentially mutating kernel. A neutral production-shaped witness covers both analysis without effects and fully absent analysis, plus CPython, dynamic, and native agreement.
risks: Prime-source IR does not yet publish buffer effect metadata, so immutable leases conservatively remain unavailable to those functions until a separate source-transparent effect analysis proves individual inputs read-only.
next_steps: Integration should rerun the rational-reduction batch regression and stage-7 production pack with its prepared FLINT addon.
A later compiler project can add prime-source buffer alias/effect analysis to recover zero-copy immutable leases for proved read-only prime inputs.
